invariants.rationale: Both return paths of the method construct and return non-null lists (either new LinkedList<> or keys, which is a parameter), so result can never be null.
The method is declared to return List<HoodieKey> and both returns are lists, so result is always a List.
Deduplication cannot increase the number of elements, so the result list size is at most the input list size.
If the input is empty, so is the result. If result is empty, then the input must have been empty as well.
Result contains only elements from the original input keys after deduplication.
